summary: No security findings. The change adds a pure save-outcome tracker (src/ui/settings/settings-save.ts), revert-on-failure logic in App.tsx, and a fixed-string role=alert message in SettingsScreen.tsx. No new trust boundary: the only inputs are the user's own Settings toggle and the local IndexedDB write result; error objects go only to console.error (unchanged from TASK-12.2) and are never rendered, so no HTML/injection path. No secrets, randomness, crypto, file I/O, or new dependencies. The fault-injection init script lives only in e2e/settings-save-failed.spec.ts and nothing in src/ references a test hook, so no production backdoor. Failed saves now fail closed (UI reverts to last known stored value).
